claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.minutes
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magical Cunning requires 1 minute (esoteric rite) to activate. ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. A timed variant is needed to model features whose activation cost is measured in minutes, not action economy.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.refill_spell_slots
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature's sole effect is to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots up to a capped fraction of the warlock's maximum. No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) captures slot refill. The v4 'refund' procedure atom and 'spell_slot' resource atom exist but are not surfaced as a ClassFeatureEffect variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots but no more than a number equal to half your maximum (round up)
